CEA Nageswaran Identifies US Trade, Energy, and AI as Key Risks

Chief Economic Advisor V. Anantha Nageswaran has identified three near-term risks facing India: challenges in US trade relations, energy security, and the artificial intelligence (AI) gap. Nageswaran suggested India needs strategic hedging to navigate these issues, particularly concerning US trade and AI headwinds.
